lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular 2D grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form prominent grid-like anchor nodes along the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from a light upper edge to a shadowed lower gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots across its visible surface area, distinct from the larger patterning on the main body.
